_notes.summary: Visual layout specification for all campaign embeds (ephemeral command responses and the persistent dashboard). Also documents the planet graph image format generated by Pillow.
_notes.embed_limits: Discord embed: max 6000 total chars, max 25 fields, field name max 256 chars, field value max 1024 chars, description max 4096 chars.
_notes.image_generation: Bot generates planet graph images in-memory using Pillow (Pillow dependency to be added to requirements.txt). Images are sent as discord.File attachments using BytesIO, then referenced in the embed via embed.set_image(url='attachment://planet_map.png'). No disk writes needed.

color_palette.company_crimson: 0x8B1A1A — dark crimson. Used for company-scoped views.
color_palette.kt_steel: 0x4A6080 — steel blue. Used for KT-scoped views.

planet_graph_image._note: Pillow-generated PNG, attached as discord.File, referenced via embed.set_image(). Generated on-demand for /campaign-orders (HC tier), /campaign-status, and the dashboard. Cached until prestige or node changes (node_id + pressure snapshot used as cache key). Canvas is 560×420px.

adjacent_node_high_pressure.note: Red outline for adjacent nodes with pressure >= 3.

medium_proximity.style: dashed — achieved with repeated short dash segments

planet_graph_image.layout_algorithm: Use x,y from jericho_reach_graph.json directly. Collect current node + all neighbors, normalize their coordinates to fit the canvas with 60px margin on all sides. Scale = (canvas_dim - 2*margin) / (max_coord - min_coord). If only 1 adjacent node, fallback to fixed positions (current center, adjacent right).
planet_graph_image.fallback: If Pillow import fails, skip image — embed still renders with text field fallback (see planet_text_fallback field in dashboard embed).

planet_graph_implementation_notes.function_signature: def render_planet_map(current_node_id: str, graph: dict, pressure: dict) -> io.BytesIO
algorithm: 1. Collect current node + all neighbors from graph['edges'] (bidirectional lookup).
2. Extract x,y for each. Normalize to canvas bounds: x_scaled = (x - x_min) / (x_max - x_min) * (width - 2*margin) + margin. Same for y.
3. Draw edges first (ImageDraw.line). Close proximity = solid 2px, medium = dashed 1px (manual dash loop).
4. Draw adjacent node circles (ImageDraw.ellipse), then current node circle on top.
5. Draw labels below each node (ImageDraw.text). Truncate long names at 20 chars.
6. Draw pressure badge top-right of adjacent nodes if pressure > 0.
planet_graph_implementation_notes.font: Use ImageFont.load_default() as fallback. Optionally load a TTF from assets/ if present.
planet_graph_implementation_notes.discord_attachment: file = discord.File(fp=planet_map_bytes, filename='planet_map.png'); embed.set_image(url='attachment://planet_map.png'); await ctx.send(embed=embed, file=file)
planet_graph_implementation_notes.caching: Cache key = (current_node_id, frozenset(pressure.items())). Store as module-level dict {key: BytesIO}. Invalidate on each campaign_log ingest that changes pressure or on beat close.
